_doc: Crafting spend tables — what a crafter buys with Advantage/Triumph and what the GM imposes with Threat/Despair. Entry shape is concept `crafting-module-concept` §4.4 as AMENDED (Amendment 1, ruling `crafting-spend-cost-shape` Q1 option (a)): the superseded `cost {symbol, count}` could not express the book's 'N Advantage OR 1 Triumph' pricing, so entries carry a `cost` display string plus a `req` ARRAY of satisfying alternatives — ANY ONE ENTRY PAYS. `req` keys are FIXED as ad/tr/th/de; a row needing any other key is a fresh R-SY4 halt, not a quiet addition. This is the same encoding the combat spend tables ship (spend_tables.json), deliberately, so the idea has one shape everywhere it appears. KEYED BY CATEGORY because RAW prints a separate spend table per category (Table 3-3 melee, Table 3-6 ranged, ...); adding a category is a data lap that adds a key (R-CRAFT-1). Every cost was read from the printed book — the OCR of this table rendered its entire cost column as noise, and R-CRAFT-4 makes the worksheet the only legal entry path.
scope: Special Modifications crafting spend tables: Brawl and Melee (Table 3-3, printed p.77), Ranged Weapons (Table 3-6, p.79), Gadgets (Table 3-14, p.84), Cybernetics (Table 3-17, p.85); Unlimited Power alchemy spend tables: Potions (Table 3-2, printed p.82), Talismans (Table 3-4, p.85); Endless Vigil lightsaber hilt spend table (Table 3-12, printed p.87); Keeping the Peace armor spend table (Table 3-2, printed p.91); Forged in Battle fortification spend table (Table 3-2, printed p.85); Special Modifications droid spend tables (Tables 3-8, 3-10, printed pp.81, 83)
